hook: Music myths that mute your clips

items.myth: Every trending song works on any account.
items.fact: Business accounts get a smaller music library.

items.myth: Music should play the whole clip.
items.fact: Drop it out right before the punchline.

caption: Which one did you believe? 🎵 Send this to a clipper who blasts music.
music: Hold On, We're Going Home Drake
